verdict.rationale: Fivetran docs explicitly document table-level and connection-level re-sync (a parent table re-sync includes child tables) without requiring pipeline rebuilds, plus MCP tooling to trigger resyncs and history/soft-delete sync modes for backfill scenarios. Community evidence corroborates that full/table re-syncs are a supported, sometimes free-of-charge operation in practice. Missing for 10: a dedicated first-party doc page specifically titled 'backfill' with step-by-step guidance across all connector types, and more independent hands-on confirmation of single-table resync ease.
